def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[[2]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for color in (8,9):
      seen=set()
      for r in range(h):
       for c in range(w):
        if grid[r][c]!=color or (r,c) in seen: continue
        st=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
        while st:
         y,x=st.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
         for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
          yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
          if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and grid[yy][xx]==color and (yy,xx) not in seen:
           seen.add((yy,xx)); st.append((yy,xx))
        a=min(y for y,x in cells); b=max(y for y,x in cells); x0=min(x for y,x in cells); x1=max(x for y,x in cells)
        # Repair holes/marker cells in rectangular color patches.
        for y in range(a,b+1):
         for x in range(x0,x1+1): out[y][x]=color
    return out
PY
